productName: Prime Care Pro Critical Illness Insurance Plan 2

trends.whatProductOffers: A participating critical illness plan covering 54 critical illnesses, 7 severe child diseases and 39 early stage critical illnesses, with cover to age 100 and a lump-sum payout on diagnosis.

keyFigures.label: Total illnesses covered
keyFigures.condition: 54 critical + 7 severe child diseases + 39 early stage

exclusionsOrConditions: Cover is limited to the 100 named illnesses in the policy; conditions outside the list are not payable.
Benefit term runs to age 100 only while premiums are paid and the policy is in force.
Brochure excerpt does not state a waiting period or the full exclusions list.

trends.whatProductOffers: Pays an advance payment for 39 early stage critical illnesses including carcinoma-in-situ, with up to 2 advance payments where carcinoma-in-situ is diagnosed in 2 different organ groups.
exclusionsOrConditions: Advance payments reduce the sum assured available for later claims.
Multiple payments for carcinoma-in-situ require diagnosis in 2 different organ groups.
Brochure excerpt does not state the advance payment percentage.
clientSignalPhrases: doesn't want to wait until stage 3
wants a second payout if it comes back elsewhere
negativeSignalPhrases: wants full sum assured for early stage

trends.talkingPointTemplate: Because {client_detail} is worried about early diagnosis, the plan pays an advance benefit at early stage, including up to two payments for carcinoma-in-situ in different organ groups.
verificationPrompts: Confirm the advance payment percentage and its effect on the remaining sum assured.
Confirm the exact organ group definitions for the 2-payment carcinoma-in-situ benefit.
sourceEvidence: It also provides cover for Carcinoma-in-situ by up to 2 advance payments if it is diagnosed in 2 different organ groups.
This plan also provides cover for diabetic complications such as Diabetic Retinopathy and Endovascular Treatment of Peripheral Arterial Disease.
